patterns: APPSC asks AP finances as single-number recall from the latest Budget/Socio-Economic Survey: debt-GSDP (34.14% BE 2024-25, 32% Dec 2022), revenue receipts 2018-19 (Rs 1,57,599 cr), interest payments, scheme allocations (Rythu Bharosa Rs 8,750 cr, Agri Gold 11.5 lakh victims/Rs 1,150 cr).
Options are deliberately close numbers (31.46/32.60/33.71/34.14), so year and BE/RE/actual distinctions are the trap.
Concept items are basic: developmental vs non-developmental (defence), ad valorem tax, Art. 280 FC; occasional statement pairs (capex <15% in 2016-21).
App MCQs go far deeper than PYQs into 2025-26 CAG monthly data, guarantees, off-budget borrowing and 16th FC grant breakups; several are near-duplicate debt/guarantee statements.
